beats.say: Walter Koenig faced only one other actor for Chekov, a contest smaller than a single coin toss.
Born Walter Marvin Koenig on 14 September 1936, he earned a Bachelor of Arts in psychology from UCLA.

shots.src: commons-search:University of California Los Angeles campus

beats.say: Yet acting called him to the screen, leading directly to the iconic bridge of the Starship Enterprise.
His big break came with a twist that had little to do with his acting or outer space.
He was cast as Chekov primarily because he resembled Davy Jones, the famous singer from The Monkees.
That role sparked a lifelong friendship, leading him to serve as best man at George Takei's wedding in 2008.
Who was your favourite crew member on the classic bridge? Walter Koenig faced only one other actor for Chekov.
